topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I've been dreading this conversation, the words stuck in my throat like a bitter pill. I should have been the one to tell you, but I let it slip through a series of texts, a coward's way out. Now, the silence between us stretches long and cold. I know I should reach out, say something to make it right, to bridge the gap that's widening by the day. But every word feels hollow, every attempt at comfort a stark reminder of what we're losing. I keep thinking about all the times we said we'd always be there for each other, no matter what. Now, the 'no matter what' part seems to have limits I never wanted to test.
